Sabeco Saigon Chill 4.6%
Not sure if I can tell this from regular Saigon lager. Maybe a tad less bitter. I’m not sure I expected different even though the can says limited addition. 6/10
Aside: I did not choose my snack well. Too much toffee stuck in my teeth. 6/10
